subject: Re: Kickoff: Dichotomy of Control for reliable automation agents
body:
Ulla,

Sizing is done. This is CPU-and-small-GPU work, so no cluster reservations needed -- a handful of Titan A100s best-effort covers the neural runs.

Staffing March-May: Jorge 50% on environment setup and the dice_rl dependency (the offline datasets for Bandit and FrozenLake come from create_dataset.sh once dice_rl is installed, but its pinned deps fight our base image -- he is containerizing it). Carmen 40% on reproducing the tabular results and the DoC-vs-DT comparison. Linnea 30% ramping on the neural DT path, scaling up in the final month.

One feasibility note: the ops simulator is much noisier than FrozenLake, so if DoC's advantage does not transfer, that is a legitimate finding, not a failure. Framing it that way now so June is not a fire drill.

Deshawn
